# Torsten Jansson – Sveriges mest älskade vd?

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a special Börslunch (EFN) episode with New Wave founder and CEO Torsten Jansson. He talks about the weak economy, which he says is slowly improving, the currency effects on New Wave and the recent acquisitions of Ulfsport, Cotton Classics and BTC. He discusses his 30 MSEK insider purchase and says he is positive about 2027, although New Wave will not reach its margin targets that year because of heavy investment, including a new ERP system. He also says he regrets buying Orrefors Kosta Boda, calls defence and AI a bubble, and mentions private holdings in Volvo, Investor and Kinnevik. A market segment covers analyst rating changes: Danske Bank upgraded Scandi Standard to buy, while Pareto and others cut ratings on Husqvarna, Gränges and Medicover.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NEWA-B — New Wave | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

CEO bought 30 MSEK of shares. Positive outlook for 2027, customers more upbeat, acquisitions bought cheap in the downturn, and the aim is to at least double the company.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's (CEO's) view, backed by a large insider purchase. Acquisitions bought for symbolic prices (Ulfsport) bring cross-selling and purchasing synergies. The weak krona is roughly neutral. 2027 margins will still be held back by ERP and warehouse spending, and Orrefors Kosta Boda remains a drag, so any rerating is long-term rather than near-term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2027 demand recovery fails to materialise
- if the Ulfsport/Kempa turnaround stalls
- if Orrefors Kosta Boda losses widen
- if ERP costs overrun further

> *"Ja, 2027 tror jag faktiskt... Faktiskt kan bli positivt. Sen kommer vi inte till att nå marginalmålen 2027."*

---

### 🟢 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Jansson recently bought privately. He sees it as very undervalued and trusts the long-established company, but calls it a gamble.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's private investment, a valuation bet. He admits he understands the company less well than his other holdings and calls the position speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the discount to net asset value persists or portfolio write-downs continue

> *"Det är lite mer en chansning då. Men de tyckte jag såg väldigt lågt värderade ut."*

---

### 🟡 VOLV-B — Volvo | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Jansson likes 'boring' companies he understands and calls Volvo a fantastic company.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's general quality preference. He gives no valuation argument.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the truck cycle deteriorates sharply

> *"Volvo, AB till exempel, tycker jag är ett fantastiskt företag."*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Jansson calls Investor another good company he likes.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's brief endorsement of quality. He gives no detail.

> *"Investor tycker jag är ett annat som är bra."*

---

### 🟢 SCST — Scandi Standard | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Danske Bank raised its rating to buy and the stock is up 10.2%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst upgrade (Danske Bank), reported by the market reporter. It is not the hosts' own view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the upgrade momentum fades or earnings disappoint

> *"Danska har höjt sin rekommendation till köp, så den går upp till 10,2 %."*

### ⛔ HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Pareto cut its rating and the stock is down 1.8%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst downgrade (Pareto), not the hosts' own view.

> *"Husqvarna är ner 1,8. Det handlar också om en rekommendationssänkning från Pareto"*

### ⛔ GRNG — Gränges | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Analyst rating cut, as reported in the market update.

#### Reasoning

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Analyst rating cut, as reported in the market update.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst downgrade. The broker and details are not given.

> *"och även i Gränges och Medicover så är det också det."*

### 🟠 SECARE — Swedencare | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO has resigned and a pre-earnings call is held today, which could move the stock.

#### Reasoning

This is event-driven news from the market reporter. The management change adds uncertainty, but no directional view is given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the pre-earnings call signals weaker guidance

> *"I Swedicare är det faktiskt så att vdn har avgått och de har ett pre-earlings-call idag"*
